item.title: Battalion Thunder
item.description: The film from the Blowhorn homepage. A 41-second introduction with burned-in captions: install Blowhorn on as many computers as you like, they fall in as one unit, from a fireteam up, one order goes to one computer, your team joins as a squad, and Major Blowhorn's one call lands on LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Reddit, GitHub, Hacker News and Slack.
